mapper.select: SELECT batch_id, batch_no, count(*) as materialCount, sum(COALESCE(remaining_qty, required_qty - issued_qty)) as totalRemainingQty FROM mis_production_material WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND (remaining_qty > 0 OR (required_qty - issued_qty) > 0) GROUP BY batch_id, batch_no

SELECT PM.*,COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity - s.locked_qty), 0) AS availableStockQty
FROM mis_production_material pm
LEFT JOIN mis_stock s ON pm.material_id = s.goods_id
AND pm.del_flag='0'
AND pm.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productionMaterial.orderNo}, '%')
AND pm.batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productionMaterial.batchNo}, '%')
AND pm.warehouse_id = #{productionMaterial.warehouseId}
AND pm.material_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productionMaterial.materialCode}, '%')
AND pm.material_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productionMaterial.materialName}, '%')
AND pm.status = #{productionMaterial.status}
GROUP BY pm.id ORDER BY pm.id DESC
